dmn_experiences.title: A Tasting Tour of London's Craft Breweries
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Bermondsey's beer mile, visiting four taprooms with tutored tastings led by an accredited Beer Sommelier and Certified Cicerone. Groups are limited to 14 people.
highlights: Visits four taprooms on Bermondsey's beer mile
Tutored tastings led by a Beer Sommelier and Certified Cicerone
Learn about beer styles, history and how to evaluate beer
Small groups of up to 14 people

dmn_experiences.title: Crate's Beer Tasting + Brewery Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of CRATE Brewery in Hackney Wick with tastings of its craft beers. A premium option adds cheese and charcuterie sharing platters.
highlights: Behind-the-scenes tour of the Hackney Wick brewery
Guided tastings of CRATE craft beers
Premium option includes cheese and charcuterie platters
Several start times through the day

dmn_experiences.title: Welsh Whisky Masterclass & Food Pairing
dmn_experiences.summary: A two-hour tutored tasting of five Penderyn Welsh whiskies, each paired with a traditional Welsh dish, hosted by a whisky writer and awards judge.
highlights: Five paired Welsh dishes, including rarebit, cawl and bara brith
Hosted by a whisky writer and World Whisky Awards judge

dmn_experiences.title: Beavertown Beer Tasting & Food Pairing
dmn_experiences.summary: An evening at The Windmill in Clapham pairing four sliders with four Beavertown beers, designed by the head chef and brewery team, finishing with a pint of Neck Oil.
highlights: Four sliders paired with four Beavertown beers
Pairings designed by the head chef and brewery team
Complimentary pint of Neck Oil to finish
Beavertown goodie bag to take home
